name: vercel
description: Vercel integration — inspect deployments, projects, and environment variable metadata via the Vercel REST API.
author: Buildersoft LLC

integration.description: Vercel deployments, projects, and environment configuration

fields.label: Access Token
fields.helpText: A Vercel access token with read access.

fields.label: Team ID
fields.helpText: For team-scoped resources. Leave blank to use your personal scope.

tools.name: vercel.list_deployments
tools.description: List recent deployments, optionally filtered by project and state.

projectId.description: Filter to a project id or name

state.description: Filter by state (e.g. BUILDING, READY, ERROR, CANCELED)

tools.name: vercel.get_deployment
tools.description: Get a single deployment by id or URL.

tools.name: vercel.list_projects
tools.description: List projects in the current scope.

tools.name: vercel.get_project
tools.description: Get a single project by id or name.

tools.name: vercel.list_env
tools.description: List a project's environment variable keys and targets. Never returns decrypted values.
